rules: Use multi-stage build — compile in golang:X-alpine, final stage FROM scratch
Set CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux for a fully static binary
Copy only the compiled binary and CA certificates into the final stage
Copy go.mod and go.sum before source code to leverage module cache
Add HEALTHCHECK using the binary's own health flag
Use EXPOSE to document the listening port
securityRequirements: Final stage must be FROM scratch or distroless — no shell
No secrets or .env files in the build context
Add a .dockerignore that excludes .git and local test artefacts
Binary must not run as root (use distroless nonroot if scratch is not feasible)
